schemes.title: HimSeva — Himachal Pradesh e-District Certificates
schemes.department: Department of Revenue, Government of Himachal Pradesh
schemes.brief: HimSeva is Himachal Pradesh's e-District system. Bonafide Himachali, income, caste, agriculturist and other revenue certificates are applied for here instead of at the tehsil, which in the hills can be several hours away.
schemes.benefit: Bonafide Himachali, income, caste and agriculturist certificates applied for online
eligibility: Resident of Himachal Pradesh, applying in the tehsil where the family lives
A bonafide Himachali certificate needs proof the family has lived in the state for the qualifying period
An agriculturist certificate needs land recorded in the family's name in Himachal Pradesh
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Parivar register (parivar nakal) copy from the panchayat
Land record (jamabandi) copy, for an agriculturist certificate
Father's caste certificate, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Bonafide Himachali, income, caste, agriculturist, character or a revenue service. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family in the parivar register and the revenue records.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Panchayat or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Parivar Register number
demoFields.hint: The panchayat's family register entry. Most Himachal certificates are checked against it, so get a fresh copy before applying.

demoFields.label: Years resident in Himachal Pradesh
demoFields.hint: For the bonafide Himachali certificate. The parivar register and old land records are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year including farming and horticulture.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get a current copy of the parivar register from your panchayat first. Most Himachal certificates are verified against it and the file stops without it.
Register on himseva.hp.gov.in with your mobile, or use a Lok Mitra Kendra, which files it for the notified fee.
Choose the certificate and fill the form from your Aadhaar, ration card and parivar register.
Upload the documents, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The patwari and the panchayat secretary verify the family, then the Tehsildar signs.
Download the signed certificate from the same login. A digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
If it is delayed beyond the time the service promises, quote the application number at the tehsil and then at the Deputy Commissioner's office.
schemes.helpline: 1100 — Himachal Pradesh CM Seva Sankalp helpline

schemes.title: Himachal Pradesh Ration Card — ePDS
schemes.department: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs, Himachal Pradesh
schemes.brief: Himachal Pradesh's ration card system, where you check the family's card, see what the depot issued in your name, add or remove a member, and apply for a new card. The state gives subsidised pulses and oil alongside the NFSA grain, so the card is worth keeping correct even for families above the poverty line.
schemes.benefit: Ration card with NFSA grain, and the state's subsidised pulses, oil and salt
eligibility: Family resident in Himachal Pradesh and holding no ration card elsewhere in India
NFSA category decided from the household's circumstances; other families get an APL card with the state subsidy
A woman of the household aged 18 or above is recorded as head of the family
Every member's Aadhaar must be seeded, or that member's share is not issued
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Parivar register (parivar nakal) copy from the panchayat
Address proof — electricity bill or house tax receipt
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, where a member has moved in
Birth certificate for a newborn, or marriage certificate for a bride
Gas connection number
Passport photograph of the head of the family

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, correct a detail, or check the depot's issue against your name.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. Leave it blank only for a brand new card.

demoFields.label: Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: A woman of the household aged 18 or above. The card is issued in her name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The family's entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Name as on that person's own Aadhaar, and the relation to the head.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.value: Marriage on 07-04-2026; deletion certificate from parents' card at Karsog
demoFields.hint: A bride needs the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from her parents' card. A newborn needs only the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Panchayat or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The depot is allotted from this address.

demoFields.label: Fair Price Shop (depot) code
demoFields.hint: Printed on the card and on the depot's board. It tells the office which register to update.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and each month's issue message come here.

demoSteps: Open epds.hp.gov.in and search your card first. The same site shows what the depot recorded as issued in your name each month.
Choose the service you need, or take the papers to the Inspector, Food and Civil Supplies of your circle, who files it across the counter.
List every member who eats from the same kitchen, each with the exact Aadhaar. The grain and the subsidised pulses are counted per name.
Attach the parivar register copy, the address proof, and for a member moving in the deletion certificate from the old card.
The inspector verifies the household and the card is issued or updated. Download it and check every name and Aadhaar.
Get the new member's Aadhaar seeded at the depot's ePoS machine. Until then the family's quantity does not increase.
If the record shows grain issued in a month you did not collect any, that is the evidence. Take a printout to the Inspector and complain on 1967.
schemes.helpline: 1967 and 1800 180 8026 — HP Food and Civil Supplies

schemes.title: e-UNNAT Jammu & Kashmir — Certificates and Services
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology, Jammu and Kashmir
schemes.brief: e-UNNAT brings the services of nearly every Jammu and Kashmir department into one place — domicile, income, category and other certificates, revenue services, scheme applications and departmental permissions, each with a delivery time set under the Public Services Guarantee Act.
schemes.benefit: Domicile, income and category certificates and departmental services in one place
eligibility: Resident of Jammu and Kashmir, applying in the tehsil where the family lives
A domicile certificate has its own conditions on years of residence, study or service in the union territory
A category certificate is issued for the categories notified for Jammu and Kashmir
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Permanent Resident Certificate of a parent, or other proof of residence, for a domicile certificate
School leaving certificate or Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Electricity bill or rent agreement for the address
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Domicile, income, category, character or a revenue service. Each has its own form, fee and delivery time.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: For a domicile certificate this matters most, since the claim usually runs through a parent's residence.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Basis of the domicile claim
demoFields.value: Father holds a Permanent Resident Certificate of J&K
demoFields.hint: Residence for the qualifying period, a parent's PRC, study in the union territory, or government service. Say which one and attach its proof.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on eunnat.jk.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or go to a Common Service Centre, which files it for the notified fee.
Choose the service and fill the form. For a domicile certificate, state clearly which ground you are claiming under and attach the proof for that ground.
Upload the documents, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The patwari and the tehsil staff verify the family. Be reachable on the mobile you gave.
The Tehsildar signs the certificate and it is downloaded from the same login.
Each service has a delivery time under the Public Services Guarantee Act. If it passes, the Act gives you an appeal, and the application number is what you quote.
